active_decisions.what: Unified call_id streaming model for all stages
active_decisions.why: 所有 LLM 调用（顺序/并行）统一通过 call_id 标记 chunk。前端按 call_id 路由到独立 DOM 块。左侧显示 LLM 输出过程，右侧显示结构化产出。Agent 模式的 ReAct 事件也走同一机制。

active_decisions.what: Docker reproduction is auto-generated, not agent-driven
active_decisions.why: 复现文件生成是纯流程逻辑（收集脚本名+依赖→模板渲染），不需要 LLM 参与。放在 Execute finalize 中自动执行，Agent 无需感知，避免额外 token 消耗和不确定性。

active_decisions.what: Inter-stage data flow through DB, not stage.output (supersedes decision-003)
active_decisions.why: Agent 模式下工具直接写 DB，stage.output 字符串直传无法覆盖这个路径。统一为 DB 作为 stage 间数据总线：Agent 用 DB tools 读写，Gemini/Mock 由 pipeline 从 DB 读取注入 prompt。decision-003 的 stage.output 机制降级为 pipeline 内部实现细节，不再是架构约束。

active_decisions.what: LLMClient.stream() yields StreamEvent, pipeline is the only broadcast point
active_decisions.why: Client 不应该持有 broadcast 回调。所有 LLM 事件（content/think/tool/tokens）统一通过 StreamEvent 交给 pipeline dispatch，新增 Agent 框架只需映射事件类型，不需要重写广播逻辑。

active_decisions.what: Pipeline is 3 stages (Refine → Research → Write); Research internally orchestrates decompose/execute/evaluate cycle
active_decisions.why: Plan and Execute were merged because Plan's sole consumer was Execute, and the feedback loop (evaluate → re-decompose) is naturally an execution concern, not an orchestration concern

active_decisions.what: Research internal state (calibration, strategy, scores) must be persisted to DB, not held in memory only
active_decisions.why: Memory-only state is lost on pause/resume, breaking checkpoint recovery. All state that survives across iterations must have a DB file.
